title: Giant Amplifiers and Talk-Show Platforms on X
question: Which mega-accounts and daily shows take claims originating in
scope: X public posts; T0 last 30 days; amplification tests = 72h after seed posts
publicInterestBasis: Mega-accounts convert niche claims into million-view distribution;
unknowns: **Done for 6 of the 19 cross relays (Phase 3, §8 "Downstream reach"):** none moved mass distribution at sampled depth; the remaining 13 relays were not expanded (budget priority went to case-01 trees). Seed negatives (claim_01) are now explicitly window-scoped to August 2026 (PHASE3 §6.5).
Nawfal's 2026-09-05 22:0x burst cadence vs the wire-credit pattern deserves a dedicated high-resolution pass (300 posts/2 days is beyond any other subject).
Owen Jones T0 Israel-topic volume was immaterial — keep him tier-2 for the next cycle unless his volume spikes.
The `marioo` shell should be re-checked at next snapshot for first-post activation (cheap user/info + timeline).
Retweeter pull for seed 2 returned empty from the API; the Phase-3 re-pull stayed `empty_inconclusive` after two retries — no retweet-side power claim is made for that seed.
contradictions: Documented disconfirming queries (each stored as claim_evidence rows; sources `src_disconfirm_cx01–cx14`):

Adversarial-reviewer check (arXiv:2502.17344, Pante et al. 2025): the synchrony "significant" pairs are exactly the suspiciousness pattern Pante flags — mixed leads, effect sizes 1.8–3.5 on a convenience sample with a demonstrated artifact (guardian pair). High posting rate alone must not manufacture significance; accordingly **no `inferred_coordination` relationship exists in this case** and none is planned without a multi-trace, null-filtered analysis output.

overturned.prior: "Zero roster amplification of tested >1M seed posts, high confidence, n=11"
overturned.now: OVERTURNED as a general claim; retired. Seed-specific negative result kept at medium with a power note (claim_01)
overturned.status: The n=11/n=40 first-page audit was unpowered and was generalized into "mega-accounts don't touch seed content." The 4,385-item structural recompute shows 19 cross-family relays and 216 self/family relays. The two tested seeds still show zero roster quotes (n=264, upper bound ~1.14%) — that part survives, at medium.

2.8% topic share measured over 109 in-window posts; cx04 found 4 residual Israel-term posts; her conflict attention runs through the Kirk-investigation economy (7 of her 19 cross relays are manosphere/Kirk-case quotes).

overturned.now: Retired — no in-harvest support in T0
overturned.status: The Aug-26 edge came from mirror-site stubs. The T0 primary harvest shows Smith quoting Yakoby adversarially twice (real, recorded as rel_09-adjacent context), but no recurring QT-fight pattern; rel_05 deleted, replaced by the observed Nawfal-moderated Dershowitz debate interaction (rel_09).

overturned.prior: "Quote-audit of two seed posts found zero roster amplifiers" as a role description of the group
overturned.status: Volume behavior (claim_04, claim_07) shows the group's amplification is mostly self-referential (Nawfal 44 self-relays; MoatsTV→Galloway 43), not cross-cluster boosting.
